cotinus_coggygria.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for yellow-oranges; iron for a strong darkening.
pH: neutral to slightly acidic.
Temperature: hot extraction; the wood needs a longer one.
Eco print: the leaves are strong under an iron modifier.
cotinus_coggygria.Багрилна съставка: Cotinus coggygria contains flavonoids such as fisetin and fustin in the wood, and appreciable tannins and polyphenols in other parts. The flavonoids give the yellow-orange; the tannins react with iron into dark complexes.
cotinus_coggygria.Как се държи: Leaves, bark and wood give yellow, orange-brown and dark muted tones. The wood is a historically important source of yellow flavonoid dyes, and the leaves are useful for a contrasting eco print.
cotinus_coggygria.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: the material is usually bought as ready shavings, chips or powder; if gathering your own, use only legally obtained or waste wood.
What is used: leaves · bark · wood.
Processing: cut or crush into small pieces for better extraction; dry material can be soaked beforehand.
Storage: fully dry, somewhere dark and airy.

cornus_mas.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for lighter yellow-beiges; iron to darken.
pH: neutral is a good starting point.
Temperature: hot extraction.
Eco print: the leaves can give a shape, but they are not among the most contrasting tannin plants.
cornus_mas.Багрилна съставка: The colour comes from a mixture of polyphenols, flavonoids and tannin compounds among them. These interact with metal mordants and give the yellow-brown to grey range.
cornus_mas.Как се държи: Leaves and bark give yellow-beige through yellow-brown. The dye strength is moderate and depends on the season and the part; bark usually gives the deeper result.
cornus_mas.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: leaves — sound and fully grown during the active season; bark — only from prunings, fallen or cut branches.
What is used: leaves · bark.
Processing: use the leaves fresh or dry them in the shade; chop the bark small before drying and extracting.
Storage: dry, dark and airy. Never strip bark right around the trunk of a living tree.

cornus_sanguinea.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a lighter yellow-brown; iron to darken.
pH: neutral is a good starting point.
Temperature: hot extraction.
Eco print: the leaves can give a shape, but they are not among the strongest tannin printers.
cornus_sanguinea.Багрилна съставка: The leaves and bark contain a mixture of flavonoids, tannins and other polyphenols. They give the yellow-brown tones and react with iron ions towards a darker grey range.
cornus_sanguinea.Как се държи: Leaves and bark give yellow-brown and darker muted tones. As with cornelian cherry, the result is moderate and depends on the part and the season.
cornus_sanguinea.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: leaves — sound and fully grown during the active season; bark — only from prunings, fallen or already cut branches.
What is used: leaves · bark.
Processing: use the leaves fresh or dry them in the shade; chop the bark small before extracting.
Storage: dry and dark. Never ring-strip bark from a living tree.

crataegus_monogyna.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for cleaner light tones; iron for brown or grey.
pH: the fruit is more pH-sensitive than the leaves and bark.
Temperature: leaves and bark — hot extraction; fruit — gentler heat.
Eco print: the leaves can give an outline, but they are not among the strongest tannin printers.
crataegus_monogyna.Багрилна съставка: Leaves, bark and fruit contain different polyphenols — flavonoids, procyanidins and tannin compounds. The fruit also holds red anthocyanin pigments, which are more sensitive to pH and to light.
crataegus_monogyna.Как се държи: The different parts give fairly soft yellow-browns, golds and reddish browns; the fruit can bring in a redder note, but a less stable one. Results vary a great deal with the part used.
crataegus_monogyna.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: flowers — at full bloom; leaves — sound and grown; fruit — as it ripens; bark — only from prunings or cut branches.
What is used: bark · leaves · flowers · fruit.
Processing: use flowers and leaves fresh or dry them quickly in the shade; the fruit can be used fresh or dried; chop the bark small.
Storage: keep the parts separate and fully dry, in the dark.

geranium_macrorrhizum.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a softer brown; iron for dark brown to grey-black.
pH: neutral is a good starting point.
Temperature: hot extraction.
Eco print: useful where a dark tannin outline is wanted.
geranium_macrorrhizum.Багрилна съставка: The rhizomes and leaves contain polyphenols and tannin compounds. The tannins react with iron ions to form dark complexes, which is why an iron modifier gives near-black results.
geranium_macrorrhizum.Как се държи: The rhizomes and leaves give browns through to very dark tones, particularly in the presence of iron. The colour is tannic and muted rather than bright. In eco print the leaves can leave a distinct dark silhouette on an iron-modified ground.
geranium_macrorrhizum.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: during the growing season, on a dry day; choose sound, fully grown leaves and tops. For flowering herbs, from the beginning of bloom to full bloom is the most practical window.
What is gathered: rhizomes · leaves.
Processing: use fresh or dry in the shade, in a thin layer with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

hypericum_perforatum.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for lighter yellow-greens; iron for olive.
pH: can change the colour noticeably.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction; avoid boiling longer than necessary.
Eco print: the flowers and leaves leave marks and texture, but this is not a classic strong tannin printer.
hypericum_perforatum.Багрилна съставка: The plant contains several groups of pigment and phenolic compounds — flavonoids, hypericin pigments and other polyphenols. A water bath usually extracts mainly the yellow-brown phenolic fraction; the conditions of extraction decide which groups dominate.
hypericum_perforatum.Как се държи: The flowering tops give yellow-greens, olives and browns; other processes can bring out reddish tones, though these are neither as easy to obtain nor as easy to keep. The colour is sensitive to the part, the maturity and the pH.
hypericum_perforatum.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: flowers · leaves · the aerial parts.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.
